Are you looking for a hands-on role as a Warehouse Associate in Best, where you can work in a structured and international environment? Do you enjoy working independently while keeping everything organized and accurate? This is your chance to join a modern warehouse team at Edmund Optics. Where quality, safety, and teamwork are key. Apply today and take the next step in your logistics career!

Employment agency Manpower is looking for a Warehouse Associate for Edmund Optics in Best.

In this warehouse position, you are responsible for accurate and timely handling of incoming and outgoing goods in a small warehouse environment. Your tasks include:

    - Performing daily cycle counts to ensure inventory accuracy
    
- Receiving inbound goods and correctly storing inventory
    
- Picking customer orders to achieve 100% on-time shipments
    
- Processing shipments via courier portals
    
- Maintaining a safe, efficient and tidy working area
    
- Confirming and completing all orders at the end of each shift

Important: this is a small warehouse without use of EPT, reach truck or forklift equipment.

What’s in it for you

    - Gross salary of €16.00 per hour
    
- Travel allowance according to client policy
    
- Pension accrual via Manpower
    
- Free access to the Manpower Academy e-learning platform
    
- Full-time job of 40 hours per week
    
- Temporary employment contract
    
- Long-term position

    - Several years of experience in a warehouse environment is preferred
    
- Fluent English, both written and verbal (Dutch is a plus)
    
- Experience with relevant SAP warehouse transactions
    
- Basic IT skills (Outlook, Teams, Excel)
    
- Ability to follow safety rules and procedures strictly
    
- Good communication and organizational skills
    
- Availability of 40 hours per week

Do you meet the job requirements and are you interested in this position? Apply today and Manpower will contact you within two working days!

The Analytical Center of Excellence (ACE) organization is looking for a 
Junior Analytical Technician 
(full shift) in the Chemicals lab located in Terneuzen, The Netherlands.
 

The Chemicals lab in is one of the Manufacturing Production Quality (MPQ) labs that performs analysis of plant-samples in Terneuzen. Servings multiple production plants such as polyurethanes and polyglycols results in the need for a 24/7 service and a full-shift roster to perform the analysis of all plant samples.
 

Responsibilities
 
 

• Ensure service requests are accurately run, and the data returned as per sample plan. 

• Analytical equipment operations and troubleshooting as per procedures. 

• Provide input of quality data into LIMS, document and communicate results. 

• Perform calibration and first line-maintenance of analytical equipment. Document/administrate these maintenance activities. Communicate maintenance work when required. 

• Apply Environmental Health & Safety (EH&S), Analytical Work Process and Operating Discipline/Quality System procedures and practices as well as cGMP/pharma standards. 

• Participating in and completing of laboratory training and corporate required trainings. 

• Co-operate and communicate with co-workers and clients to maintain workflow and instrumental information, and to share and leverage problem solving and prevention expertise. 

• Contribute to value creation by continuous improvement of procedures in the analytical work processes and related tools and performance metrics. 

• Promote a well-organized, responsive, efficient workplace and work well both as a team member and independently. 

Qualifications
 
 

• MBO-4 laboratory degree or similar (bachelors degree preferred). 

• Fluent in Dutch and English. 

• Experience in an industrial laboratory (analytical) 

• Able to work in full shift (24/7 roster): morning, afternoon and night shifts.  

 
 

Preferred qualifications
 
 

• GMP/pharma experience. 

• Experience in operation, calibration, maintenance and troubleshooting of analytical equipment. 

• Knowledge of quality data systems like LIMS, OpenLab, etc. 

• Good lab techniques, methodical record keeping, and the ability to work both independently and with co-workers. 

• Excellent human relations, organizational and communication skills are necessary to communicate with team members, partners and outside customers. 

• Exhibit confidence in confirming validity of methods and data. 

• Able to handle multiple tasks and work under pressure.

jobs.description:
Looking for the perfect part-time job? You’re in the right place! Manpower is hiring mail sorters for PostNL in Zwolle at Anthony Fokkerstraat 2, 8013 NS. 

What we ask from you:

You have your own transport (due to limited accessibility) and are preferably available for other shifts besides the afternoon shift. There is no guarantee of fixed hours your schedule depends on the workload at PostNL. However, you must be available at least 15 hours per week. Shifts last between 3 to 5 hours and may vary weekly.

Manpower is hiring mail sorters for the afternoon shift at PostNL in Kampen.

You’ll operate sorting machines to process national mail. This is a physical job: you'll be standing, lifting heavy mail bins, and working accurately to ensure proper delivery.

What you get

    - Gross salary of €14.99 per hour
    
- Travel reimbursement (PostNL rates)
    
- Contract via Manpower
    
- Pension accrual via Manpower
    
- Access to 200+ online courses through Manpower Academy
    
- Shift bonuses: +20% (8 PM–10 PM), +40% (10 PM–6 AM)

    - Good command of Dutch and/or English (for safety instructions and communication)
    
- Own transport for early, evening, and night shifts
    
- Able to provide a valid Certificate of Conduct (VOG)

You can start as soon as possible! Don’t wait apply today and Manpower will contact you within two working days.
